**Repeats within 5 minutes now drop.** Keyed on `event.key`.

99 dropped, zero errors. State holds `lastSentByKey`, a `Map`. It updates only when something actually ships, so a drop does not extend the window.

I read "in the last 5 minutes" as a strict `< 5`. A repeat at exactly 5 minutes goes through.

Logic is at [src/router.js:41](src/router.js:41).
